chapter.title: Reading Section
chapter.source: ETS — TOEFL iBT® Practice Test 2 (aligned with tests from January 21, 2026)

summary: Reading section of the official ETS Practice Test 2, in two modules of 20 questions. Each module: Complete the Words (Questions 1–10), Read in Daily Life (11–15) and Read an Academic Passage (16–20). Answers come from the ETS answer keys (PDF pp. 13–14), which list answers only, without explanations.

complete_the_words.title: Module 1 · Questions 1–10 · Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
complete_the_words.text: Maps are tools that help us understand the world around us. They {sh|ow} the {loca|tions} of {pla|ces} like {cit|ies}, rivers, {a|nd} mountains. {Th|ese} visual {gu|ides} can {al|so} display different {ty|pes} of {infor|mation}, such as climate or population. There are many kinds, including physical, political, and thematic versions. The study of maps and cartography, the process by which they are made, can teach us about the geography of our planet and how people live in different regions.

complete_the_words.title: Module 2 · Questions 1–10 · Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
complete_the_words.text: Elephants are social animals that live in groups called herds. They {commu|nicate} using {sou|nds}, gestures, {a|nd} touch. These {ani|mals} are {kn|own} for {th|eir} strong {fam|ily} bonds and {of|ten} help {ea|ch} other {i|n} times of need. They can remember the locations of water sources and food, which helps them survive in their natural environment. These highly intelligent creatures play an important role in their ecosystems, shaping the landscape, creating access to moisture, and spreading seeds.

passage.title: Module 1 · Read an academic passage (the highlighted word is in [brackets])
passage.text:
The Impact of Sports on Social Integration

Sports can promote social integration by bridging gaps between people of various backgrounds. Participation in sports can lead to increased social [cohesion] and improved relationships among diverse groups.

For example, community soccer leagues often bring together people from different ethnicities, creating an environment where cultural differences are celebrated and mutual respect is cultivated. However, the impact of sports on social integration is not without challenges. Competitive environments can sometimes exacerbate social tensions, particularly when favoritism or exclusionary practices are present.

Despite these issues, many initiatives aim to use sports as a platform for social change. One such initiative is the Sport for Peace program, which focuses on conflict resolution through team-building activities and collaborative sports events. The role of sports in social integration extends beyond participation. Spectatorship and fandom also play significant roles in uniting people. Major international sports events like the Olympics or the World Cup serve as opportunities for nations to come together and share common goals. The visibility of athletes from diverse backgrounds during these events fosters a sense of global harmony. These events often highlight stories of athletes overcoming adversity, inspiring spectators and fostering a collective sense of achievement.

multiple_choice_questions.question: 16. The word “cohesion” in the passage is closest in meaning to
choices: diversity
awareness
unity
celebration
multiple_choice_questions.answer: unity
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (C) unity

multiple_choice_questions.question: 17. In which of the following situations can sports have an especially negative impact on social integration?
choices: When people from different ethnicities are brought together
When participants are unreasonably strict about the rules of competition
When the social environment is not favorable to competition
When social tensions are heightened by favoring or excluding certain participants
multiple_choice_questions.answer: When social tensions are heightened by favoring or excluding certain participants
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (D) When social tensions are heightened by favoring or excluding certain participants

multiple_choice_questions.question: 18. What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?
choices: Paragraph 3 discusses ways of addressing a problem mentioned in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 contradicts a theory proposed in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 provides evidence for an idea presented in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 introduces a new challenge related to paragraph 2.
multiple_choice_questions.answer: Paragraph 3 discusses ways of addressing a problem mentioned in paragraph 2.
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (A) Paragraph 3 discusses ways of addressing a problem mentioned in paragraph 2.

multiple_choice_questions.question: 19. What does the passage suggest about the Sport for Peace program?
choices: Its main goal is to eliminate favoritism in sports.
It primarily targets professional athletes.
It uses team-building exercises to address conflicts.
It is only effective in local communities.
multiple_choice_questions.answer: It uses team-building exercises to address conflicts.
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (C) It uses team-building exercises to address conflicts.

multiple_choice_questions.question: 20. Why does the author mention major international sports events like the Olympics and the World Cup?
choices: To argue that these events have little impact on social integration
To illustrate how sports can unite people globally
To suggest that these events mainly benefit athletes
To highlight the competitive nature of these events
multiple_choice_questions.answer: To illustrate how sports can unite people globally
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (B) To illustrate how sports can unite people globally

passage.title: Module 2 · Read an academic passage
passage.text:
The Human Microbiome

The human microbiome consists of trillions of microorganisms living in and on our bodies. These include bacteria, viruses, fungi, and other microbes. They play a pivotal role in functions such as digestion, immunity, and mood regulation. For instance, gut bacteria help break down food and produce essential vitamins.

Recent studies show that the microbiome can be influenced by diet, lifestyle, and medication. Antibiotics, while effective against harmful bacteria, can disrupt the balance of beneficial microbes. This disruption can lead to health issues like digestive problems and weakened immunity. Researchers are exploring the connection between the microbiome and mental health. Certain gut bacteria produce neurotransmitters affecting brain function. An imbalance in these bacteria may be linked to conditions like depression and anxiety.

Maintaining a healthy microbiome involves eating a varied diet rich in fiber, reducing stress, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics. Bacteria that aid digestion, known as probiotics and prebiotics, are also beneficial. As understanding of the microbiome grows, it may lead to breakthroughs in treating diseases and improving health.

multiple_choice_questions.question: 16. The word “pivotal” in the passage is closest in meaning to
choices: very important
possible
combined
unwelcome
multiple_choice_questions.answer: very important
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (A) very important

multiple_choice_questions.question: 17. What is one way antibiotics can affect humans?
choices: They enhance the production of neurotransmitters.
They can weaken immunity by harming beneficial microbes.
They can help relieve digestive problems.
They make it easier to produce essential vitamins.
multiple_choice_questions.answer: They can weaken immunity by harming beneficial microbes.
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (B) They can weaken immunity by harming beneficial microbes.

multiple_choice_questions.question: 18. What connection are researchers exploring regarding the microbiome?
choices: The link between gut bacteria and immunity
The role of fungi in mood regulation
The role of viruses in digestion
The link between gut bacteria and mental health
multiple_choice_questions.answer: The link between gut bacteria and mental health
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (D) The link between gut bacteria and mental health

multiple_choice_questions.question: 19. All of the following help to maintain a healthy microbiome EXCEPT
choices: eating a varied diet rich in fiber
lowering stress levels
avoiding sources of bacteria
reducing the use of antibiotics
multiple_choice_questions.answer: avoiding sources of bacteria
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (C) avoiding sources of bacteria

multiple_choice_questions.question: 20. What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?
choices: Paragraph 3 challenges the ideas proposed in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 provides examples of the disruptions mentioned in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 specifies how to achieve a healthy microbiome based on the factors mentioned in paragraph 2.
Paragraph 3 elaborates on the benefits of antibiotics mentioned in paragraph 2.
multiple_choice_questions.answer: Paragraph 3 specifies how to achieve a healthy microbiome based on the factors mentioned in paragraph 2.
multiple_choice_questions.explanation: Answer key: (C) Paragraph 3 specifies how to achieve a healthy microbiome based on the factors mentioned in paragraph 2.
